text: 8th October 2026 ttok is my CLI tool for counting tokens, using OpenAI's open source tiktoken library. It hasn't been in updated in a couple of years, but I finally fixed a Click warning, updated CI, and added a --list-models command to list available models. It works with uvx , so you can count tokens in anything like this: cat file.txt | uvx ttok Posted 8th October 2026 at 11:34 pm This is a beat by Simon Willison, posted on 8th October 2026 .
